title: Misinformation on Field Assistant recruitment
summary: The Cabinet Secretariat denies an advertisement for 1,736 Field Assistant (GD) posts and related admit cards. Check recruitment notices through official channels.

title: Digital arrest scam
summary: MHA describes digital arrest scams involving impersonation of police, CBI and other agencies. It lists blocked Skype and WhatsApp accounts and the 1930 reporting helpline.

title: India Post warns against fraudulent websites
summary: India Post disowns subsidy and prize offers spread through survey links. The advisory asks people not to respond or disclose personal information.
anchor: not involved in any such activities

title: RBI cautions about fake websites in its name
summary: RBI warns about websites impersonating the central bank and collecting confidential banking information. RBI does not hold individual accounts or solicit personal banking details.
anchor: does not hold any accounts for individuals
